_comment: Underdog payout multipliers for an entry of even-money picks (payout_multiplier 1.0) from different games. Keys are entry sizes (string-encoded ints). 'power' pays one multiplier when every pick hits. 'flex' lists the multiplier by number of losses, zero losses first; a tier Underdog does not offer is absent and pays nothing. A real slip pays the table entry times the picks' own multipliers times the same-game correlation modifier, which never exceeds 1; a Flex tier with k losses uses only the n - k largest pick multipliers. Read in the app by the owner on 2026-10-08; the 4-pick Flex one-loss tier was 1.8 in the entry_slips/estimate quotes captured 2026-09-10 (docs/underdog_api.md section 6.8). Re-confirm each season and update in place.
